<?php 
/**
* Plugin Name: Site Kit Preview Mode
* Description: Bypasses Site Kit setup for preview/demo purposes
*/
// Force setup as complete
add_filter( 'googlesitekit_setup_complete', '__return_true', 999 );
// Override Site Kit's capability mapping to allow dashboard access in preview mode
add_filter( 'map_meta_cap', function( $caps, $cap, $user_id, $args ) {
// Only for admin users
$user = get_userdata( $user_id );
if ( ! $user || ! in_array( 'administrator', $user->roles, true ) ) {
return $caps;
}
// Override Site Kit meta capabilities to allow access
$allowed_caps = array(
'googlesitekit_view_dashboard',
'googlesitekit_view_authenticated_dashboard',
'googlesitekit_view_splash',
'googlesitekit_manage_options',
'googlesitekit_view_posts_insights',
'googlesitekit_setup',
'googlesitekit_authenticate',
);
if ( in_array( $cap, $allowed_caps, true ) ) {
return array();
}
return $caps;
}, 999, 4 );
// Provide mock credentials
add_filter( 'option_googlesitekit_credentials', function( $value ) {
if ( empty( $value ) ) {
return array(
'oauth2_client_id' => 'preview-client.apps.googleusercontent.com',
'oauth2_client_secret' => 'preview-secret-key',
);
}
return $value;
}, 1 );
// Provide mock Search Console property (required for setup completion)
add_filter( 'option_googlesitekit_search-console_settings', function( $value ) {
if ( empty( $value ) || ! isset( $value['propertyID'] ) ) {
return array(
'propertyID' => 'sc-domain:' . parse_url( home_url(), PHP_URL_HOST ),
'ownerID' => 1,
);
}
return $value;
}, 1 );
// Set owner ID to current user
add_filter( 'option_googlesitekit_owner_id', function( $value ) {
if ( empty( $value ) ) {
$current_user = wp_get_current_user();
return $current_user->ID;
}
return $value;
}, 1 );
// Set has connected admins
add_filter( 'option_googlesitekit_has_connected_admins', function( $value ) {
return empty( $value ) ? 1 : $value;
}, 1 );
// Mock user as authenticated and verified
add_filter( 'get_user_metadata', function( $value, $object_id, $meta_key, $single ) {
// Only process Site Kit meta keys to avoid infinite loops
if ( strpos( $meta_key, 'googlesitekit' ) === false ) {
return null;
}
// Only for admin users - check if this user is an admin
$current_user = wp_get_current_user();
if ( $object_id !== $current_user->ID || ! in_array( 'administrator', $current_user->roles, true ) ) {
return null;
}
// Strip wp_ prefix if present
$clean_key = str_replace( 'wp_', '', $meta_key );
$mock_meta = array(
'googlesitekit_site_verified_meta' => '1',
'googlesitekit_access_token' => 'ya29.mock_access_token',
'googlesitekit_access_token_expires_in' => 3600,
'googlesitekit_access_token_created_at' => time(),
'googlesitekit_refresh_token' => '1//mock_refresh_token',
'googlesitekit_auth_scopes' => array(
'openid',
'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.profile',
'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email',
'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/siteverification',
'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters',
),
'googlesitekitpersistent_initial_version' => '1.0.0',
'googlesitekitpersistent_dismissed_items' => array(),
);
// Handle profile specially - must be wrapped in array with numeric index
if ( $clean_key === 'googlesitekit_profile' ) {
$profile = array(
'email' => 'admin@example.com',
'photo' => '',
'full_name' => 'Admin User',
);
// Always return wrapped in [0 => value] format
// WordPress will extract [0] if $single = true
return array( 0 => $profile );
}
if ( isset( $mock_meta[ $clean_key ] ) ) {
// For arrays like dismissed_items, wrap in [0 => value]
// For scalar values, WordPress expects [0 => value] format too
$value = $mock_meta[ $clean_key ];
return array( 0 => $value );
}
// Return null to allow WordPress to continue with default behavior
return null;
}, 1, 4 );
// Mock REST API responses - use rest_pre_dispatch to prevent actual API calls
add_filter( 'rest_pre_dispatch', function( $result, $server, $request ) {
$route = $request->get_route();
// Mock Search Console data - intercept before API call
if ( strpos( $route, '/google-site-kit/v1/modules/search-console/data/' ) !== false ) {
// Mock search analytics data with weekend fluctuation
if ( strpos( $route, 'searchanalytics' ) !== false ) {
$mock_data = array();
$start_date = strtotime( '-27 days' );
for ( $i = 0; $i < 28; $i++ ) {
$date = strtotime( "+{$i} days", $start_date );
$day_of_week = (int) date( 'w', $date );
$is_weekend = ( $day_of_week === 0 || $day_of_week === 6 );
$base_clicks = 145 + ( $i * 2.5 );
$base_impressions = 3400 + ( $i * 40 );
if ( $is_weekend ) {
$clicks = (int) ( $base_clicks * 0.65 );
$impressions = (int) ( $base_impressions * 0.7 );
$position = 11.5 + ( rand( 0, 6 ) / 10 );
} else {
$clicks = (int) ( $base_clicks + rand( -15, 15 ) );
$impressions = (int) ( $base_impressions + rand( -200, 200 ) );
$position = 10.0 + ( rand( 0, 8 ) / 10 );
}
$mock_data[] = array(
'keys' => array( date( 'Y-m-d', $date ) ),
'clicks' => $clicks,
'impressions' => $impressions,
'ctr' => round( $clicks / $impressions, 3 ),
'position' => $position,
);
}
return rest_ensure_response( $mock_data );
}
}
// Mock PageSpeed Insights data
if ( strpos( $route, '/google-site-kit/v1/modules/pagespeed-insights/data/' ) !== false ) {
return rest_ensure_response( array(
'loadingExperience' => array(
'metrics' => array(
'CUMULATIVE_LAYOUT_SHIFT_SCORE' => array( 'percentile' => 0.05, 'category' => 'FAST' ),
'FIRST_CONTENTFUL_PAINT_MS' => array( 'percentile' => 1800, 'category' => 'FAST' ),
'FIRST_INPUT_DELAY_MS' => array( 'percentile' => 13, 'category' => 'FAST' ),
'LARGEST_CONTENTFUL_PAINT_MS' => array( 'percentile' => 2400, 'category' => 'FAST' ),
'INTERACTION_TO_NEXT_PAINT' => array( 'percentile' => 150, 'category' => 'FAST' ),
),
'overall_category' => 'FAST',
),
'lighthouseResult' => array(
'categories' => array(
'performance' => array( 'score' => 0.92 ),
'accessibility' => array( 'score' => 0.95 ),
'best-practices' => array( 'score' => 0.88 ),
'seo' => array( 'score' => 0.97 ),
),
'audits' => array(
'first-contentful-paint' => array( 'displayValue' => '1.8 s', 'score' => 0.95 ),
'largest-contentful-paint' => array( 'displayValue' => '2.4 s', 'score' => 0.90 ),
'total-blocking-time' => array( 'displayValue' => '150 ms', 'score' => 0.92 ),
'cumulative-layout-shift' => array( 'displayValue' => '0.05', 'score' => 0.97 ),
'speed-index' => array( 'displayValue' => '3.2 s', 'score' => 0.89 ),
),
),
) );
}
return $result;
}, 10, 3 );
// Mock REST API responses - use rest_post_dispatch to override actual responses
add_filter( 'rest_post_dispatch', function( $response, $server, $request ) {
$route = $request->get_route();
// Mock connection status
if ( $route === '/google-site-kit/v1/core/site/data/connection' ) {
$current_user = wp_get_current_user();
$data = array(
'connected' => true,
'resettable' => false,
'setupCompleted' => true,
'hasConnectedAdmins' => true,
'hasMultipleAdmins' => false,
'ownerID' => $current_user->ID,
);
$response->set_data( $data );
return $response;
}
// Mock user authentication status
if ( $route === '/google-site-kit/v1/core/user/data/authentication' ) {
$user = wp_get_current_user();
if ( $user && in_array( 'administrator', $user->roles, true ) ) {
$data = array(
'authenticated' => true,
'requiredScopes' => array(),
'grantedScopes' => array(
'openid',
'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.profile',
'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email',
'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/siteverification',
'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters',
),
'unsatisfiedScopes' => array(),
'needsReauthentication' => false,
'disconnectedReason' => '',
'connectedProxyURL' => home_url(),
);
$response->set_data( $data );
return $response;
}
}
// Mock user permissions
if ( $route === '/google-site-kit/v1/core/user/data/permissions' ) {
$user = wp_get_current_user();
if ( $user && in_array( 'administrator', $user->roles, true ) ) {
$data = $response->get_data();
// Override specific permissions
$data['googlesitekit_view_dashboard'] = true;
$data['googlesitekit_view_authenticated_dashboard'] = true;
$data['googlesitekit_manage_options'] = true;
$response->set_data( $data );
return $response;
}
}
return $response;
}, 999, 3 );
